coverage.finding: The ink folio label '303b.' is in the top-left margin, with the 'b' superscript and followed by a dot. The candidate's literal text matches the image.

This is the single cramped ink line at the page foot. It runs from a tick at x≈360 to the gutter at x≈3060 and crosses the vertical ruled line at x≈810. The legible frame is secure: 'c. 390(9).', the title, 'unb. f. 88', 'foll. by part f. of śrāddhatext', 'f. 89. Begins', 'n.d.' and the closing abbreviation. The incipit words and the two middle elements of the formula stay uncertain, which the candidate correctly keeps flagged. The terminal left-pointing arrow appears to be drawn over or through the final abbreviation ('Bey.[?]'), not after it; the candidate does not record this.

This is the indented second line in a lighter grey stroke: 'Begins Tatra pūrvadine niāmiṣaḥ sakṛtbhojanaḥ', with a separate arrow at x≈3000–3070. The candidate's literal text and its flags match the image. Whether it is the incipit of the f. 89 part or a later supplement remains unresolved.

review.boundary_review: The gutter lies at about native x≈3080. Everything to its right (f. 9, d. 77(2), c. 326(2) … c. 117(10), c. 368(7), b. 95(5), plus marginal notes such as '? Sasyādāne…', 'RLM, IX, 3127…' and 'see …') belongs to fol. 304. It is context only and is not recorded as target records. The arrows at the end of b002 and b003 stand on the 303b side, against the gutter. The matching marks ('→' and '—') are on the 304 side. The attachment relationship remains probable or uncertain, not resolved.

region_review.bottom: There are two lines (b002 ink, b003 lighter stroke), each with a gutter arrow. No further writing appears below them, down to the page edge at y≈4850.
region_review.left_margin: Only the tick and the start of b002 at the foot, and the folio label at the top. No other marginalia.
region_review.right_margin: The gutter area holds only the arrows of b002 and b003. Beyond it is the facing fol. 304, which is context only.
region_review.interlinear: No interlinear additions were found apart from the stacked letters at the end of b002 (the formula and abbreviation), which form part of that line.
